title: IIT Bombay: overview, contacts and student portals
content:
# IIT Bombay: overview, contacts and student portals

**Indian Institute of Technology Bombay** (IIT Bombay, IITB), Powai, Mumbai 400 076, Maharashtra, India.

## Contacts
- Board line: +91 (22) 2572 2545 (9:15 am – 5:45 pm, Monday–Friday)
- JEE (Advanced) and UCEED: +91 (22) 2576 4063 / 9093 / 9094; jeeadv@iitb.ac.in, uceed@iitb.ac.in
- GATE office: +91 (22) 2576 7068; gateoffice@iitb.ac.in
- CEED: ceed@iitb.ac.in
- Student Wellness Centre: 022-2576-9070; office.swc@iitb.ac.in
- Campus telephone directory: http://portal.iitb.ac.in/telephone/

## Student portals
- Academic Office: https://acad.iitb.ac.in/
- ASC (course registration and records): https://asc.iitb.ac.in/acadmenu/
- Course listing: https://portal.iitb.ac.in/asc/Courses
- Moodle: https://moodle.iitb.ac.in
- Placements: https://campus.placements.iitb.ac.in/
- Central Library: https://www.library.iitb.ac.in/
- Gymkhana (student body): https://gymkhana.iitb.ac.in/
- Dean of Student Affairs: https://dosa.iitb.ac.in
- Computer Centre: https://www.cc.iitb.ac.in/
- IT applications: https://access.iitb.ac.in
- Hospital: https://newsurveys.iitb.ac.in/hospital/
- InstiApp (campus app and map): https://insti.app/map

Hostel allotment: ask the Dean of Student Affairs office (https://dosa.iitb.ac.in); hostel fee circulars are on the Academic Office fees page.

title: IIT Bombay admissions: routes by programme (2026-27)
content:
# IIT Bombay admissions: routes by programme (2026-27)

## Undergraduate (https://acad.iitb.ac.in/admissions/bachelors)
- **B.Tech (4-year)** and **B.Tech + M.Tech dual degree (5-year, Electrical Engineering):** through **JEE (Advanced)**, with seats allotted by **JoSAA** (https://josaa.nic.in/). Eligibility: https://jeeadv.ac.in/
- **B.S.** (Chemistry, Economics, Mathematics, Applied Geophysics): through the exams listed on the page; IIT Bombay also admits a few students who qualify the **Indian National Mathematical Olympiad (INMO)**.
- **B.Des** (IDC School of Design): through **UCEED** (https://www.uceed.iitb.ac.in/).

## Postgraduate (https://acad.iitb.ac.in/admissions/masters)
- **M.Tech** (2-year full-time, 3-year part-time): GATE-based (GATE: www.gate.iitb.ac.in); apply on https://portal.iitb.ac.in. TA, TAP, RA and RAP offers run through **COAP**. Exceptions per programme are in the brochure.
- **M.Sc and M.Sc + PhD:** https://acad.iitb.ac.in/admissions/masters/msc
- **M.Des:** through **CEED** (www.ceed.iitb.ac.in).

## PhD (https://acad.iitb.ac.in/admissions/research)
- Admissions open for **AY 2026-27, Spring Semester**; apply at http://portal.iitb.ac.in/. Brochure, advertisement and tentative schedule are linked as PDFs.
- Monthly assistantship: **Rs. 37,000** for the first 2 years (TA); **Rs. 42,000** for the first 2 years (RA).
- PMRF: **Rs 70,000/month** stipend and **Rs 2 lakh** annual contingency grant.
- Double Doctoral Degree Programme with Tohoku University: https://acad.iitb.ac.in/double-doctoral-degree-program-dddp

title: IIT Bombay academic calendar, timetables, fees and Student Wellness Centre
content:
# IIT Bombay academic calendar, timetables, fees and Student Wellness Centre

## Calendar and timetables (https://acad.iitb.ac.in/academics/calendar-and-timetable)
Open the PDFs for exact dates:
- Academic Calendar 2026-27 (revised), the current cycle; earlier calendars for 2025-26, 2024-25 and 2023-24.
- Senate meetings calendar for 2026.
- **End-semester exam timetable, Autumn 2026-27**, and seating arrangements for quizzes and end-semester exams.
- Autumn semester timetable for UG/PG common courses and the slot pattern; classroom locations and room booking.

## Fees (https://acad.iitb.ac.in/fees-structure-prospective-students)
Amounts are in the linked PDFs: hostel fee structure for new UG and PG/PhD students (Autumn 2026-27), fee schedule for new UG entrants (Autumn 2026-27), and a fee circular dated **10.07.2026** for on-roll students.

## Student Wellness Centre (https://swc.iitb.ac.in)
- 6th Floor, N SAC Building, opposite DSSE Building, IIT Bombay, Powai, Mumbai 400076
- Phone: 022-2576-9070 · Email: office.swc@iitb.ac.in
- One-on-one counselling, group therapy, mindfulness workshops and peer support. Book at https://app.swc.iitb.ac.in/
- **Urgent support:** https://swc.iitb.ac.in/urgent-support
- Hostel wellbeing counsellors: weekdays 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Friday 3:00 – 5:00 PM); a weekend roster is on the site.
